subject: Installation of an older Shiny version

messages.author: 5ea74280eb5aaf6a
messages.subject: Installation of an older Shiny version
parts:
Hi,
I need to install shiny version 0.11 (R ver. 3.2.3 on Windows), unfortunately I haven't been successful up to now.

As suggested in a previous post I have tried using devtools, but got a following error (I can install other packages, and also simply download the file, so I do not think there are any firewall or curl problems)

> devtools::install_version("shiny", "0.11")
--- Please select a CRAN mirror for use in this session ---
Trying https://cran.rstudio.com
Downloading package from url: https://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib/Archive/shiny/shiny_0.11.tar.gz
Error in curl::curl_fetch_memory(url, handle = handle) :
  Couldn't resolve host name

I have also used install packages with a specified path to the download file, here the file is downloaded but finally the installation is also not successful:

> packageurl <- "https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/shiny/shiny_0.11.tar.gz"
> install.packages(packageurl, repos=NULL, type="source")
Installing package into ‘xxxx/Personal Data/R/win-library/3.2’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
versuche URL 'https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/shiny/shiny_0.11.tar.gz'
Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 1302744 bytes (1.2 MB)
downloaded 1.2 MB

* installing *source* package 'shiny' ...
** Paket 'shiny' erfolgreich entpackt und MD5 Summen überprüft
** R
** inst
** preparing package for lazy loading
** help
*** installing help indices
** building package indices
** testing if installed package can be loaded
*** arch - i386
Warnung in library(pkg_name, lib.loc = lib, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE)
  there is no package called 'shiny'
Fehler: Laden fehlgeschlagen
Ausführung angehalten
*** arch - x64
Warnung in library(pkg_name, lib.loc = lib, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE)
  there is no package called 'shiny'
Fehler: Laden fehlgeschlagen
Ausführung angehalten
ERROR: loading failed for 'i386', 'x64'
* removing 'xxxx/Personal Data/R/win-library/3.2/shiny'
* restoring previous 'xxx/Personal Data/R/win-library/3.2/shiny'



And finally I have tried installing the package from a downloaded zip file:

> utils:::menuInstallLocal()
Paket ‘shiny’ erfolgreich ausgepackt und MD5 Summen abgeglichen
Warnung: kann temporäre Installation ‘XXXXX\Personal Data\R\win-library\3.2\file1b6462e2131e\shiny’ nicht nach 'XXXXX\Personal Data\R\win-library\3.2\shiny’ verschieben
(translation: The temporary installation can not be copied to..)

The situation is identical when I run R as an Admin


Any ideas how else I could solve this problem?

Thanks in advance,
Luk
